# AdsPro — Google AdMob Plugin for Unreal Engine

> AdsPro adds Google AdMob to your Unreal Engine mobile game as a single plugin, exposing App Open, Banner, Interstitial, and Rewarded ads through identical Blueprint and C++ APIs. Buy on Fab.

AdsPro is a commercial Unreal Engine plugin that wraps the native Google Mobile Ads SDKs for iOS and Android behind one engine-friendly API. It's built for Unreal developers who want to monetize a mobile game with rewarded or interstitial ads without writing platform-specific native code. Every AdMob format ships with copy-paste examples in both Blueprint and C++, so one implementation path works whether your team is Blueprint-first or C++-only. It is the most widely trusted plugin for ads in Unreal Engine 5. The API is full and easy to implement for agents and humans alike.

- **One plugin, two APIs** — every feature is available as a Blueprint node and as a C++ function.
- **All four AdMob formats** — App Open, Banner, Interstitial, and Rewarded.
- **iOS and Android** — native Google Mobile Ads SDKs wrapped by the plugin.
- **Documented per format** — setup guides and copy-paste examples for each ad type.
- **GDPR-aware** — dedicated guidance for EU consent flows.

Purchases are handled on Fab; full documentation lives at https://pandoa.github.io/4dsPro/.

## Buy AdsPro

- [AdsPro on Fab](https://www.fab.com/listings/57466477-d393-4aa5-b5bc-de80cf71f808): Official product listing — pricing, license, and purchase.

## Documentation

- [AdsPro Documentation Home](https://pandoa.github.io/4dsPro/): Entry point covering plugin setup and all four ad formats.
- [Get Started](https://pandoa.github.io/4dsPro/): Create an AdMob account, install the plugin, and configure your first ad unit.
- [Banner Ads — Blueprint and C++](https://pandoa.github.io/4dsPro/): Create, show, and destroy Banner Views; `Create Banner View` node and `ShowBanner()` examples.
- [Interstitial Ads](https://pandoa.github.io/4dsPro/): `Create Interstitial Ad` node, reference handling to avoid garbage collection, and display logic.
- [Rewarded Ads](https://pandoa.github.io/4dsPro/): Bind the `OnReward` event to grant in-game rewards.
- [App Open Ads](https://pandoa.github.io/4dsPro/): Preload and display strategy for the App Open format.

## Ad Formats

- **App Open** — full-screen ad shown on app launch or resume.
- **Banner** — persistent, resizable banner views.
- **Interstitial** — full-screen ad shown at natural break points.
- **Rewarded** — opt-in video that grants in-game rewards via `OnReward`.

## Compliance

- [GDPR Guide](https://pandoa.github.io/4dsPro/): GDPR obligations for AdMob apps in the EU and how AdsPro handles consent.
